title: Tag-along object follows the incoming missile in the Bluegill Triple Prime report
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Tag-along object follows the incoming missile in the Bluegill Triple Prime report, about October 1962 at Johnston Atoll (Bluegill, 1962), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh but when you did that, you noticed that there had been some object that had appeared on the screen and joined and tagged along following the incoming missile down.

related.note: Both are about the anomalous object seen at the Bluegill Triple Prime test in October 1962. Here it was an object that joined and followed the incoming missile, not material tumbling out of the plume.

plain: Harald Malmgren, who says he was an advisor to US presidents, describes a report on Bluegill Triple Prime, a 1962 American nuclear test set off high above the Pacific near Johnston Island. He says the tracking screens showed an unknown object appear, join the incoming missile, and follow it all the way down, and he places the report in the circle of President Kennedy and Defense Secretary Robert McNamara. If true, it would mean something unexplained was shadowing a US nuclear test.
